"""Finite serial checkpoints for this live LOW owner; never calls image services."""
import json,os,subprocess,sys,time,traceback
from pathlib import Path
sys.path.insert(0,str(Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]))
from tools.common import ROOT,read_json,write_json,machine_id,utc_now
run_id='resume-20261025-large-logical-queue-v5'
folder=ROOT/'runtime/resume-low-20261025';state_file=folder/'publisher-state.json'
lock=folder/'publisher.lock';fd=os.open(lock,os.O_CREAT|os.O_EXCL|os.O_WRONLY)
os.write(fd,str(os.getpid()).encode('ascii'));os.close(fd)
state={'machine_id':machine_id(),'pid':os.getpid(),'run_id':run_id,'started_at_utc':utc_now(),'status':'starting','checkpoints':[],'scope':'Finite 6h30m Git-only checkpoint helper. No image tool, EvoLink, source generation, review approval or canonical portrait writes. Ordinary fast-forward pushes and pinned raw-byte verification only.'}
deadline=time.monotonic()+23400;last=-1
def persist(**kw):state.update(kw,observed_at_utc=utc_now());write_json(state_file,state)
def checked(args,timeout=1800):
 r=subprocess.run(args,cwd=ROOT,capture_output=True,text=True,encoding='utf-8',errors='replace',timeout=timeout)
 if r.returncode:raise RuntimeError(r.stdout+'\n'+r.stderr)
 return r.stdout
try:
 while time.monotonic()<deadline:
  owner_path=ROOT/'runtime/rolling-production/owner.json'
  live=owner_path.exists() and read_json(owner_path).get('run_id')==run_id
  production=read_json(ROOT/f'runtime/rolling-production/{run_id}.json')
  calls=production['completed_source_requests'];running=live and production['status']=='running'
  if last>=0 and calls-last<16 and running:
   persist(status='waiting_for_next_16_completed_requests',last_completed_requests=calls,last_checkpoint_requests=last)
   time.sleep(20);continue
  if last==calls and not running:break
  # Wait for an earlier pinned readback; never remove an unknown lock.
  readback=ROOT/'runtime/master-git-readback.lock'
  if readback.exists():
   persist(status='waiting_for_existing_original_readback',last_completed_requests=calls)
   time.sleep(20);continue
  seq=len(state['checkpoints'])+1;batch='resumed-low-auto-'+str(seq)+'-20261025'
  while (ROOT/'runtime/low-scoped-checkpoints'/batch).exists():
   seq+=1;batch='resumed-low-auto-'+str(seq)+'-20261025'
  persist(status='snapshotting_LOW_scope',last_completed_requests=calls)
  stdout=checked([sys.executable,'-X','utf8',str(ROOT/'runtime/low-scoped-checkpoint-20261025.py'),batch,'--incremental'])
  receipt=read_json(ROOT/'runtime/low-scoped-checkpoints'/batch/'receipt.json')
  target=ROOT/f'runtime/checkpoint-{batch}.json';assert not target.exists()
  write_json(target,{**receipt,'isolated_git_synchronization':{'status':'pending_in_separate_network_publisher','primary_worktree_untouched':True}})
  state['checkpoints'].append({'batch':batch,'commit':receipt['commit'],'completed_requests_at_snapshot':calls,'new_original_PNGs':receipt['new_original_PNGs']})
  while readback.exists():
   persist(status='snapshot_committed_waiting_for_prior_raw_readback')
   if time.monotonic()>=deadline:raise TimeoutError('Finite publisher deadline; committed snapshot preserved for later push, no image replay')
   time.sleep(20)
  persist(status='publishing_and_verifying_immutable_snapshot')
  checked([sys.executable,str(ROOT/'tools/production_checkpoint_publish.py'),receipt['commit'],batch],timeout=1800)
  proof=read_json(target);assert proof['status']=='committed_pushed_and_originals_verified',proof['status']
  last=calls;persist(status='checkpoint_pushed_and_raw_bytes_verified',last_checkpoint_requests=last,last_commit=receipt['commit'])
  if not running:break
 persist(status='finished_at_owner_boundary_or_finite_deadline',finished_at_utc=utc_now())
except BaseException:
 persist(status='stopped_requires_reconciliation_no_image_replay',error=traceback.format_exc());raise
finally:
 assert lock.read_text() == str(os.getpid());lock.unlink()
